evidence.trustReason: Fresh-context Layer 3 review; re-run at HEAD 14cbaffb08 (file sha256 84a0d4cd05638ede, unchanged since commit): bun exit 0, 3 pass, 0 fail, 171 expect(). Titles name default 4. No mocks: release-notes.spec through loadPlan (real Blend.load and TaskCommand.plan); facts folded through TaskEngineXState.apply; reads through TaskStatus.project, the snapshot history, RunSupervisor.tagsOf, engine.waitingOn/stopOf/ended. Given: T1.1 trusted (tags [ended]); T1.2 building on attempt 2 (tags [active, building]) with obligations [failed, trusted, trusted, trusted]; T1.3 tags [waiting, ready], which only the machine's ready state carries (CLASS); T1.4 tags [waiting], waiting on [T1.2, T1.3]; no dead task; run not ended. When: run.cancelled with a reason. Then: the unfinished tasks are exactly [T1, T1.2, T1.3, T1.4, T1.5]; each is cancelled with that reason and tags [ended, stopped]; the history adds exactly one entry each for T1.2 (building to cancelled), T1.3 and T1.4 (to cancelled) with that reason; every scenario is cancelled with that reason. And: T1.1's status entry is unchanged and it gets no new entry; the obligations map (states, reasons, times) is equal before and after, the stop writes no obligation entry, each obligation's task carries the ended tag, and the machine is final. And: run cancelled, reason exactly the cancel reason, tags [ended, stopped], stopOf {cancelled, reason}; control: the same cancel after T1.2 needs a human gives needs_human with first line 'T1.2 needs human' and last line the stop reason, so 'because no task died' is causal. And wall clock: the exact fact the run supervisor's wallClock region records (run.ended failed, 'wall clock: ...', checked in src) passes the same unit checks and gives run failed with that reason and stopOf {failed, reason}. No gap found.

Scenario: RM14 A cancel moves every unfinished unit to cancelled and keeps the finished ones (default 4)
    Given a run with a trusted task, a building task, a ready task and a waiting task
    When the run is cancelled with a reason
    Then the building, ready and waiting tasks are cancelled with that reason
    And the trusted task stays trusted, and every obligation keeps its state and ends with its task
    And the run outcome is cancelled with that reason, because no task died before the stop
    And a run wall-clock stop gives the run.ended state as the outcome in the same way
